description: This file defines the ViewUIConverter class, which handles converting view entities for the Drupal Views UI, including loading from temp store and applying status changes.

classes.name: ViewUIConverter
classes.description: A class that converts view entities for the Drupal Views UI, supporting temp store loading and status synchronization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies including entity type manager, temp store factory, config factory, admin context, and entity repository.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a view entity, loading from temp store if available, and synchronizing its status.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Determines if this converter applies based on route definition and parameters, specifically for 'entity:view' with tempstore option.
